properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 25 at 4:01PM MDT until October 25 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding continues, especially along the Conejos River

* WHERE...Southeastern Conejos County in south central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 715 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding will continue across low-lying and flood-prone
locations, especially along and near the Conejos River.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 356 PM MDT, River gauge reports indicate elevated river levels
continue due to multiple days of heavy rainfall. The Conejos
River at Mogote has crested, although high flows and flooding
will persist, especially downstream from Mogote to the confluence
with the Rio Grande.
- Some locations that may experience flooding include...
Manassa, Sanford and Conejos.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 25 at 3:12PM MDT until October 27 at 12:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Colorado...

Rio Grande At Alamosa affecting Alamosa County.

For the Upper Rio Grande...including Alamosa...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Rio Grande at Alamosa.

* WHEN...From this evening to Tuesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 9.0 feet, Minor flooding. Minor agricultural flooding
in low lying areas along the river

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:30 PM MDT Sunday the stage was 8.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 7.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
evening to a crest of 9.6 feet tomorrow morning. It will then
fall below flood stage early Tuesday morning.
- Flood stage is 9.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 9.9
feet on 06/05/1948.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 25 at 2:07PM MDT until October 27 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Catastrophic flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected along the San Juan River between Four Corners and Mexican
Hat. This is an emergency situation!

* WHERE...Western Montezuma County in southwestern Colorado...
Southern San Juan County in southeastern Utah...

* WHEN...Until 600 AM MDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding along San Juan River is occurring or expected to
begin shortly. The crest will occur around Aneth, Montezuma Creek
and Bluff this afternoon and evening.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 204 PM MDT, Sunday the stage for the San Juan river near Bluff
was 20 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
afternoon to a crest of 29.5 feet early Monday morning. It will
then fall below flood stage early Tuesday morning.
- Flood stage is 23.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 32.0
feet on 09/10/1927.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mexican Hat, Tselakai Dezza, Bluff, Halchita, Montezuma Creek and
Aneth.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 25 at 1:30PM MDT until October 25 at 7:30PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding continues, especially along the Rio Grande and area
waterways downstream from Monte Vista.

* WHERE...Southeastern Rio Grande County in south central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 730 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations continues. Numerous roads remain closed
due to flooding, including Highway 112 between Del Norte and
Center, and Highway 285 between Monte Vista and Center.  Expect
many areas of slow moving or standing water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 120 PM MDT, the Rio Grande has crested at Del Norte and Monte
Vista, however, flooding continues over low lying areas near the
river and many waterways and agricultural areas away from the
river remain flooded as well.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Monte Vista.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 25 at 9:00AM MDT until October 27 at 9:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall which occurred over
the last couple of days is expected or ongoing.

* WHERE...Northeastern Conejos County in south central Colorado...
Southwestern Alamosa County in southeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 900 AM MDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding will occur in low-lying and flood-prone
locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 852 AM MDT, flooding was occurring along the Rio Grande River
in low lying and agricultural areas. This high water is due to
all of the heavy rain which occurred over the last couple of
days.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include low lying
areas in parts of Alamosa and parts of Conejos counties.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Watch issued October 25 at 8:05AM MDT until October 26 at 12:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southwest Colorado, including the following
areas, Animas River Basin, Four Corners/Upper Dolores River, San
Juan River Basin and Southwest San Juan Mountains and Utah,
including the following areas, Arches/Grand Flat,
Canyonlands/Natural Bridges, La Sal and Abajo Mountains and
Southeast Utah.

* WHEN...Through this evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, recent burn scars and other low-lying and
flood-prone locations. Low-water crossings may be flooded. Storm
drains and ditches may become clogged with debris.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Flooding is imminent or ongoing with additional rounds of showers
and thunderstorms expected through Sunday afternoon. Rivers and
creeks may still experience high waters even after rainfall has
ended.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.areaDesc: Northwestern San Juan Mountains; Southwest San Juan Mountains; Four Corners/Upper Dolores River; Animas River Basin; San Juan River Basin; Southeast Utah

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 24 at 5:29PM MDT until October 25 at 9:45PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding likely along the Rio Grande between Monte Vista and
Alamosa.

* WHERE...Southeastern Rio Grande County and West Central Alamosa
County...

* WHEN...Until 945 PM MDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding along the Rio Grande and low lying agricultural
areas in Rio Grande and Alamosa counties is occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 525 PM MDT, Emergency management reports flooding of low lying
areas along and near the Rio Grande in Rio Grande county and in
Alamosa county upstream of the city of Alamosa.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Southeastern Rio Grande and West Central
Alamosa Counties between Monte Vista and Alamosa.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
